title: Nvidia CEO's daughter cancels planned visit to S. Korea: sources
caption:
Madison Huang's planned visit to Seoul for Nvidia AI Day 2026 has been abruptly called off. While family issues are cited, industry observers are questioning if recent reports played a part.
